description: Run a scripted play-test: (re)start the game, then execute steps in order — wait_for, assert, input, query, screenshot, wait_ms, assert_no_errors, set, call, repeat — stopping at the first failure. Returns a summary with per-step result, what was checked and the observed value, game errors, and screenshots; report='full' adds the JSON report. Pass a YAML/JSON file in the project (path), a folder or a list of files (paths) to run several and get one summary, or an inline scenario. save_to keeps the screenshots and a report as files in the project. movie records every frame with Godot's Movie Maker (fixed frame rate, needs a game window) and saves movie.gif plus contact.png — a grid of evenly spaced frames, also returned as an image so you can see the motion.

include_screenshots.description: Attach screenshots as images (default true; for a folder or paths, default is failure screenshots only).

movie.description: Record the run with Movie Maker (one scenario; needs save_to and a game window — not with --headless in Main Run Args). Waits in the scenario are game time, so prefer frame-based steps for exact timing.

fps.description: Recording rate (default 30). The game runs at this fixed step, as fast as it can render.

frames.description: Also keep every recorded frame as frames/frameNNNNNNNN.png (default false).

from_step.description: First scenario step to keep in the GIF/contact sheet (1-based; default 1). The whole run is still recorded — the frames are cut afterwards.

gif_fps.description: GIF frame rate (default 15; at most fps). Long recordings are thinned to 300 GIF frames.

max_width.description: GIF width in pixels (default 480; never enlarged).

to_step.description: Last scenario step to keep (1-based, inclusive; default the last step).

path.description: Scenario file, e.g. 'res://tests/scenarios/move.yaml', or a folder to run every .yaml/.yml/.json file in it (natural name order, so 2_ runs before 10_).

paths.description: Several scenario files, run in the given order.

report.description: 'summary' (default) or 'full' to also return the JSON report.

save_to.description: Folder in the project for evidence, e.g. 'res://qa/evidence/move': every screenshot as NN-label.png, report.md and report.json (a folder run: one subfolder per scenario plus summary.md). Re-runs replace their own files; the editor does not import the folder (.gdignore). Not undoable.

scenario.description: Inline scenario as YAML text or an object: {name, scene?, steps: [...]}.

stop_on_failure.description: With a folder or paths: stop after the first scenario that does not pass.

name: scenario_run
title: Run scenario test
